result.name: nodes.setSourceMappings
result.description: Replace the complete source mappings and evidence without changing ASCII, content anchors, or layout. Requires the current content.asciiSha256 as expectedContentHash. Omitted source preserves the repository binding; empty mappings/evidence clears mappings. Undoable and persisted in workspace history; proposal calls stay isolated.

result.name: nodes.patchDiagram
result.description: Replace 1-based inclusive raw ASCII lines. Empty patch deletes lines; trailing newline inserts a blank line. Ranges address the current document (later calls see earlier committed edits). Untouched mappings and source jumps shift; intersecting mappings are removed and changed anchors remain stale. Shared content updates all its instances. Undoable; no save.

result.name: nodes.setJumps
result.description: Replace diagram-local jumps without changing ASCII. Source ranges are original 1-based inclusive columns on the current content revision/hash; contentNodeId is optional. Target representationId is a saved catalog canvas ID, not a live canvasId. Empty list removes all jumps. Undoable; explicit save required.

result.name: edges.list
result.description: Read saved diagram connections. Endpoint displayNodeId identifies a GridBox instance; contentNodeId and revisionId come from nodes.get content.structure.nodes and content. Short content-node handles are shared with live WebSocket context; full IDs remain accepted.

result.name: edges.create
result.description: Connect a content node to another content node or GridBox. appearance.label accepts {text, position?:{x,y}}; position is the label horizontal center and text baseline in absolute unscaled canvas pixels. Omit position for automatic placement. Legacy string labels remain supported. Does not change diagram content.

result.name: edges.update
result.description: Replace a connection by ID, including endpoints or appearance. appearance.label accepts {text, position?:{x,y}} in absolute unscaled canvas pixels (horizontal center, text baseline); omit position to restore automatic placement. Unchanged stale endpoints may be retained.

result.name: edges.remove
result.description: Remove one connection without deleting either diagram.

result.name: canvas.list
result.description: List registered live Mapping pages and their documents.

result.name: canvas.attach
result.description: Bind a new session to a live document. Use returned sessionId on subsequent calls.

result.name: canvas.createDocument
result.description: Create an unsaved document and attach a session. Does not create a confirmed representation.

result.name: canvas.copyDocument
result.description: Copy a live document, including unsaved edits, diagrams, mappings, edges, layout and pane presentation, into an independent unsaved draft with a fresh undo baseline. Returns its attachment. Optional expectedVersion checks the source. Use an unbound exec without sessionId or changeSessionId. Does not publish or modify the source; transient controls and pending requests are reset.

result.name: nodes.list
result.description: Read the compact API DisplayNode registry (apiFormatVersion: 1). Diagram ASCII is in content; anchors are in content.structure.nodes for both trees and unstructured diagrams. diagram contains metadata only.

result.name: nodes.get
result.description: Read a compact API DisplayNode. Read ASCII from content.ascii and anchors from Object.values(content.structure.nodes); diagram.content and contentNodes are omitted. Handles are opaque, revision-scoped, shared across API/WebSocket reads, and expire on backend restart.

result.name: nodes.draw
result.description: Create a diagram; natural content size feeds push-right grid layout. Position is parent-relative cells.
